item.text: The code confirms the access and delivery bugs: permissions allow access to other members’ notifications, “mark all read” updates the whole workspace, and inbox queries include email-only alerts. Several event handlers are also missing, and links use incomplete paths. I’m fixing these in the shared services and repositories.
